slides.text: We scheduled the database migration for a Friday night, expecting it to run over the weekend and be done by Monday standup. It wasn't.

citations.quote: We scheduled the database migration for a Friday night, expecting it to run over the weekend and be done by Monday standup.

slides.text: By Sunday afternoon, barely a third of the rows had moved, and the whole team was back online trying to figure out why.

citations.quote: By Sunday afternoon, barely a third of the rows had moved, and the whole team was back online trying to figure out why

slides.text: The dashboard turned out to be counting retried rows as new progress each time they retried, so a single stuck batch could inflate the on-screen percentage indefinitely while genuinely doing nothing.

citations.quote: turned out to be counting retried rows as new progress each time they retried, so a single stuck batch could inflate the on-screen percentage indefinitely while genuinely doing nothing

slides.text: We rewrote the progress query to count distinct row IDs instead of retry attempts.

citations.quote: We rewrote the progress query to count distinct row IDs instead of retry attempts

slides.text: The migration itself finished the following Wednesday, three days late, with no further surprises once the numbers finally meant what everyone assumed they meant.
